info.title: Jito Tips
info.description:
Jito's tip-floor service: recent landed-tip percentiles, so a searcher can price a bundle/transaction tip before submitting it.

WHY THIS IS ITS OWN SPEC: this endpoint is NOT on the Block Engine. It is served from a DIFFERENT host (bundles.jito.wtf, not <region>.mainnet.block-engine.jito.wtf) and it is plain REST, not JSON-RPC. A Gecko surface pins exactly one host (one base URL per client, so a poisoned or drifting spec can never redirect a call), so the tip floor is comprehended as its own surface rather than smuggled into the Block Engine one — where it 404'd.

Source: https://docs.jito.wtf/lowlatencytxnsend/tips/ (documented `curl https://bundles.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles/tip_floor`), verified live. A WebSocket stream of the same data exists at wss://bundles.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles/tip_stream and is deliberately NOT modeled here (Gecko comprehends HTTP surfaces).

Keyless and read-only: no auth, no signing, no spend.

servers.description: Jito bundles/tips service. NOT a Block Engine host.

get.summary: Get the recent Jito tip floor (percentiles, in SOL) to size a competitive tip.
get.description: Returns recent landed-tip statistics in SOL. Use a percentile at or above the 50th to price a bundle tip that is likely to win the auction; Jito enforces a 1000-lamport minimum, but during demand the floor is what actually matters. Plain REST GET, no parameters, no auth.

200.description: Recent tip-floor statistics (one entry per recent interval).

TipFloor.description: Recent Jito tip statistics, in SOL.
